verses.jalalayn: By the chargers, the steeds that charge in attack and snort [with a], snorting — this being the [name of the] sound which they emit from inside them when they charge;
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai un (ghodon) ki jo phunkare marte hue dhaudte hai

verses.saheeh: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
verses.khattab: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺
verses.jalalayn: by the strikers, the steeds that strike fire [by way], of sparks, with their hoofs, when they gallop across rocky terrain by night;
verses.romanUrdu: Phir (apne tapon se) chingariyan jhaadte hain

verses.jalalayn: by the dawn-raiders, the steeds that make raids against the enemy at dawn at the hands of their riders,
verses.romanUrdu: Phir subah sawere chapa marte hain

verses.jalalayn: raising, stirring up, therein, in the place of their charge or at that time [of dawn], a trail of dust, by the power of their movement,
verses.romanUrdu: Phir is mauke par gard o gubar udatey hai

verses.saheeh: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
verses.khattab: and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines
verses.jalalayn: cleaving therewith, with the dust, a host, of the enemy, that is to say, cutting right into their centre! (the verb is supplemented to the noun [in the above instances] because it serves to explain the verbal action, in other words, wa’llātī ‘adawna fa-awrayna fa-agharna, ‘by those that charge, then strike sparks, then raid’).
verses.romanUrdu: Phir isi halat mei kisi majmey ke andar ja ghustey hai

verses.saheeh: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
verses.khattab: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—
verses.jalalayn: Verily man, the disbeliever, is ungrateful to his Lord, thankless, denying [the reality of] His graces, exalted be He,
verses.romanUrdu: Haqiqat yeh hai ke Insan apne Rubb ka bada nashukra hai

verses.saheeh: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
verses.khattab: and they certainly attest to this—
verses.jalalayn: and verily to that, ingratitude of his, he is a witness, bearing witness against himself to his own actions.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh khud is par gawah hai

verses.transliteration: Wa innahu lihubbil khairi la shadeed
verses.saheeh: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
verses.khattab: and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains
verses.jalalayn: And verily in the love of wealth he is avid, and is therefore niggardly with it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh maal-o-daulat ki muhabbat mei buri tarah mubtala hai

verses.uthmani: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.indopak: اَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ اِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِى الۡقُبُوۡرِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Afala ya'lamu iza b'uthira ma filquboor
verses.saheeh: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
verses.khattab: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out
verses.jalalayn: Does he not know that, when that which is in the graves, in the way of the dead, is strewn, when it is turned over and brought out, that is to say, [that when] they are raised,
verses.romanUrdu: To kya woh us waqt ko nahin janta jab qabron mein jo kuch (madfun) hai usey nikal liya jayega

verses.saheeh: And that within the breasts is obtained,
verses.khattab: and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—
verses.jalalayn: and that which is in the breasts, the hearts, of disbelief or faith, is obtained, [when] it is revealed and examined,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur seeno mein jo kuch (makhfi) hai usey baramad karke uski jaanch padtal ki jayegi

verses.transliteration: Inna rabbahum bihim yauma 'izil la khabeer
verses.saheeh: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
verses.khattab: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day
verses.jalalayn: on that day their Lord will indeed be Aware of them, Knower [of them] and will requite them for their disbelief (the pronoun reverts to the plural because of the [collective] import of the term ‘man’; this sentence indicates the direct object of [the verb] ya‘lamu, ‘[does he not] know’, that is to say, ‘We will requite him at the time mentioned’; khabīrun, ‘Aware’, is semantically connected to yawma’idhin, ‘on that day’, even though [in fact] God is ever Aware, because that is the Day of Requital.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan unka Rubb us roz unse khoob bakhabar hoga
